name: litmine_corpus.tsv
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file

inputs.name: Europe PMC search
inputs.sha256_scope: roll-up: sha256 over the sorted sha256 digests of every cached reply body this build read from this API. A public API has no single byte stream to hash; this value is reproducible from the cache and changes when any reply changes.
queries: TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:("protein level" OR "protein levels" OR "protein abundance" OR stability OR stabilization OR degradation OR half-life OR "expression level") AND SRC:MED
TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:(phosphorylation OR ubiquitination OR ubiquitylation OR sumoylation OR acetylation) AND SRC:MED

TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:(rescue OR rescued OR restore OR restored OR restores OR complementation OR overexpression OR transgenic) AND SRC:MED

TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:("helicase activity" OR unwinding OR ATPase OR "double Holliday junction" OR dissolution OR resolvase) AND SRC:MED

TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:("sister chromatid exchange" OR "sister chromatid exchanges" OR "genome instability" OR "genomic instability" OR "chromosomal instability" OR micronuclei) AND SRC:MED
TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:(knockdown OR knockout OR depletion OR silencing OR "small molecule inhibitor" OR ML216) AND SRC:MED
inputs.known_gap: this API states no release or version in its replies, so the field is null rather than a date copied from the run.

inputs.name: Europe PMC full text
inputs.role: open-access full text (JATS XML), cached under build/it5/r3/fulltext-xml

query_log.term: TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:("protein level" OR "protein levels" OR "protein abundance" OR stability OR stabilization OR degradation OR half-life OR "expression level") AND SRC:MED
TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:(phosphorylation OR ubiquitination OR ubiquitylation OR sumoylation OR acetylation) AND SRC:MED

TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:(rescue OR rescued OR restore OR restored OR restores OR complementation OR overexpression OR transgenic) AND SRC:MED

TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:("helicase activity" OR unwinding OR ATPase OR "double Holliday junction" OR dissolution OR resolvase) AND SRC:MED

TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:("sister chromatid exchange" OR "sister chromatid exchanges" OR "genome instability" OR "genomic instability" OR "chromosomal instability" OR micronuclei) AND SRC:MED
TITLE_ABS:(BLM OR RECQL3 OR RECQ2 OR "BLM helicase" OR "Bloom helicase") AND TITLE_ABS:(knockdown OR knockout OR depletion OR silencing OR "small molecule inhibitor" OR ML216) AND SRC:MED

columns.text_kind: abstract = title + abstract from the search record; fulltext = JATS abstract + body prose (tables and reference lists dropped)
columns.text_sha256: sha256 of the UTF-8 text file build/it5/r3/docs/<pmid>.<kind>.txt the quote verifier reads
columns.queries: the query ids that retrieved the paper

sources.genomic: none: the queries name the gene, never a variant or position

assumptions: title+abstract matching finds the papers whose main subject is the gene
limitations: one page (<=1000 records) per query; full text only when open access; the cached text files stay in build/ (copyright), only their digests are committed
validation: positive control: the three control PMIDs must be retrieved (recall reported by the verify stage)
